change_reason: Initial registration of the confirmed finding from the 2026-07/2026-08 engagement evidence.

impact_claims.statement: Privilege escalation: a token scoped to one plugin reaches arbitrary catalog/scaffolder operations as an unrestricted service principal.

mechanism.statement: DefaultAuthService.getPluginRequestToken case 'service' re-mints a plugin token with only pluginId/targetPluginId, dropping the incoming principal's accessRestrictions; ServerPermissionClient.#servicePrincipalDecision treats a service principal with no restrictions as unconditional ALLOW before the operator policy.

reachability.statement: Any least-privilege external-access token, forwarded plugin→plugin, becomes unrestricted; downstream authorize()/authorizeConditional() short-circuit to ALLOW.
